method: MILP (scipy.optimize.milp / HiGHS): minimise |x| s.t. H_X x = 0 mod 2 and L_X[j].x = 1 mod 2 for at least one j; mod-2 constraints linearised with integer slacks; translation symmetry used to require the support to touch torus cell 0 (left or right block).
symmetry: d_X = d_Z verified for this code: the qubit relabelling (L,c)<->(R,-c) maps rowspace(H_Z) onto rowspace(H_X) (checked by GF(2) rank), so one side suffices.
validated_on: Solver reproduced published exact distances of [[72,12,6]] (0.1 s), [[90,8,10]] (6.8 s), [[144,12,12]] gross (35 s).
